events.title: Brussels Founded
events.description: Saint Geoffrey establishes a chapel on the Senne River, marking the beginning of Brussels.

events.title: Bruges Golden Age Begins
events.description: Bruges becomes a major center of Flemish commerce and culture, dominated by wealthy merchant families.

events.title: Burgundian Rule Begins
events.description: The Low Countries come under control of the Burgundian Dukes through dynastic marriage.

events.title: Spanish Habsburg Rule Begins
events.description: Burgundian territories pass to Spanish Habsburgs. Antwerp becomes major trading hub.

events.title: Antwerp's Golden Age
events.description: Antwerp becomes the wealthiest city in Europe, major hub for diamond and spice trade.

events.title: Iconoclastic Fury
events.description: Religious conflicts between Protestants and Catholics lead to widespread destruction of religious imagery.

events.title: Austrian Succession War
events.description: Spanish Netherlands ceded to Austria in Treaty of Utrecht, ending Spanish rule.

events.title: French Revolutionary Wars
events.description: Belgian territories become part of French Republic after invasion by French forces.

events.title: Congress of Vienna
events.description: Belgium united with Netherlands under William I of Orange-Nassau.

events.title: Belgian Independence
events.description: Belgium declares independence from Netherlands. Leopold I becomes first king of Belgium.

events.title: Industrial Revolution Peak
events.description: Coal mining and textile industries boom. Belgium becomes industrial powerhouse.

events.title: Congo Becomes Belgian Colony
events.description: Leopold II gains control of Congo, establishing brutal colonial regime and mining operations.

events.title: German Occupation in WWI
events.description: Germany invades Belgium. Four-year occupation causes massive destruction and displacement.

events.title: Battle of Ypres
events.description: Brutal trench warfare at Ypres. Hundreds of thousands killed. City heavily damaged.

events.title: WWI Ends - Belgian Liberation
events.description: Germany withdraws from Belgium. Extensive reconstruction begins across the country.

events.title: Language Border Formalized
events.description: Formal boundary established between Dutch-speaking Flanders and French-speaking Wallonia.

events.title: German Occupation in WWII
events.description: Germany invades and occupies Belgium for four years during World War II.

events.title: European Coal and Steel Community
events.description: Belgium founding member of ECSC, beginning of European integration.

events.title: Federalization Begins
events.description: Belgium begins process of federalization to accommodate linguistic and regional divisions.

events.title: Schengen Area - Open Borders
events.description: Belgium joins Schengen area, allowing free movement across European borders.

events.title: Euro Currency Adoption
events.description: Belgium adopts the Euro, replacing the Belgian Franc.
